correctness.rationale: For all admissible Newman polynomials with P(3)=289Q(3), exact digit carries c_{i+1}=(c_i+289q_i-p_i)/3 are nonnegative integers <=144. The first carry is 96 and the terminal carry is 0. From 96 exactly 32 states are reachable; they partition into 20 live and 12 closed traps without 0. The exhaustive 26 live-to-live edges preserve the unique five-denominator-digit masks and p_i=q_i-q_{i-2}-q_{i-3}+q_{i-4}+q_{i-5}, yielding P(X)=(1-X²-X³+X⁴+X⁵)Q(X) for all degrees. The ending mask 0 accounts for tails. A standalone script independently checks all finite-state assertions and one nontrivial example; bounded enumeration is only corroboration.
